name: SQL Query Builder Pro
tagline: Visual SQL query builder with drag-and-drop interface
description: Build complex SQL queries visually without writing code. Drag tables, join them, add filters, and get instant SQL output with syntax highlighting.
features: Support for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
ORDER BY and GROUP BY visual config
JOIN types: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER
Export SQL in multiple dialects (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite)

hero.headline: Build SQL Queries Without Writing Code
hero.subheadline: Visual query builder for developers who want to save time
